Three sk-code-skilled quality references restate their topic inventory in both the post-title hook and the Overview Purpose: TypeScript at `.skilled/skills/sk-code/sk-code-skilled/references/typescript/quality-standards/overview-and-type-system.md:16,24`, JavaScript at `.skilled/skills/sk-code/sk-code-skilled/references/javascript/quality-standards/overview-modules-and-docs.md:16,24`, and Shell at `.skilled/skills/sk-code/sk-code-skilled/references/shell/quality-standards/validation-security-and-shellcheck.md:16,24`. This repeats nearly the same subject list before adding a distinct purpose. The reference template marks an intro/Purpose repeat as bad structure and reserves the intro for a short summary while Overview contains details (`.skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-skill/assets/skill/skill-reference-template.md:112-145`); the asset template states the same hook/details split (`.skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-skill/assets/skill/skill-asset-template.md:174-175`). Keep each hook concise and use Purpose to explain the reader outcome rather than repeat the inventory.

`validate_document.py` has no Markdown-rendering lint for joined bold-label paragraphs, bare URLs, duplicate labels, or accidental Setext headings. The pre-fix CSS reference has adjacent unbulleted bold labels at `cd00629166:.skilled/skills/sk-code/sk-code-frontend/references/web-cascade-and-selectors.md:23-29`, raw URLs at lines 28, 37, and 46 of that file, and a repeated `Support` label at lines 58-60. The validation pipeline calls TOC, H2, general-structure, required-section, selected table, and frontmatter checks (`.skilled/skills/sk-doc/scripts/validate_document.py:2008-2029`); general structure checks dividers before numbered uppercase H2s plus TOC and anchor rules (`.skilled/skills/sk-doc/scripts/validate_document.py:667-729`). The supplied report that this file returned VALID with 0 issues is consistent with this code path. Add a Markdown AST lint outside frontmatter and fences for label paragraphs, raw URLs, repeated labels, and forbidden Setext headings; these are mechanical when the document contract is explicit.

Both resource templates warn against duplicating intro and Overview content, but their GOOD examples paraphrase the same central subject: the reference example repeats commit workflows and filtering in Purpose (`.skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-skill/assets/skill/skill-reference-template.md:86-101`), and the asset example repeats commit-message templates and formats (`.skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-skill/assets/skill/skill-asset-template.md:174-192`). This is a plausible contributor to repeated inventories found in sk-code references; authoring provenance would confirm whether it caused them. Revise the examples so the hook gives a distinct reader benefit and Purpose adds scope or outcome. Exact repeats are mechanical; semantic overlap should be advisory or human-reviewed.

The documented completion path does not make content review a blocking package check. The reference workflow points authors to the templates, then calls `package_skill.py --check --strict` authoritative and lists metadata, required SKILL.md sections, and paths as hard failures (`.skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-skill/references/skill/creation-workflow.md:313-360`). The package script validates resource-document frontmatter and version as warnings (`.skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-skill/scripts/package_skill.py:751-810,1472-1478`), while separate comprehensive-validation guidance assigns content quality and style to AI judgment (`.skilled/skills/sk-doc/sk-create-skill/references/shared/validation-and-packaging.md:117-125`). Require a content review for each changed reference/asset covering intro-to-Purpose duplication, reader-task order, and rendered Markdown. Ordering and semantic duplication need human judgment; raw links, section shape, and Markdown AST defects can be scripted.

The reference validator accepts a compound OVERVIEW heading by fuzzy word containment and never requires an overview body, so the pre-fix CSS file's first rule subsection can stand in for the overview. The heading at `cd00629166:.skilled/skills/sk-code/sk-code-frontend/references/web-cascade-and-selectors.md:19` is followed immediately by a CS1 rule subsection at `cd00629166:.skilled/skills/sk-code/sk-code-frontend/references/web-cascade-and-selectors.md:21`. The reference rule requires only an `overview` heading (`.skilled/skills/sk-doc/shared/assets/template-rules.json:319-323`), and `validate_required_sections` accepts required words anywhere in the normalized heading (`.skilled/skills/sk-doc/scripts/validate_document.py:899-915`). Require the canonical numbered `OVERVIEW` heading and a minimal orientation body; both are mechanical checks.
